limitations: Driver queries are instantaneous snapshots. External processes can begin after observation; monitoring blocks future launches and never kills them.
Persistent storage ledger needs explicit reserves for all external writes since its hashed complete-root snapshot; arbitrary output growth is not measured recursively.
Completed/failed/cancelled outputs retain storage reserves. Rebase is an offline root audit, never automatic.
The threat model covers accidental conflicts/escaped own workers, not adversarial same-UID FD transfer.
A crashed controller is never adopted. Shared leases survive inherited workers, but stdout pipe closure may also cause a worker to fail.
Requested model/seed/output are preserved logical provenance; exact worker arguments and pinned scientific guards define actual execution.
Only the six listed GPU worker modules are admitted; new entries require source compatibility review.
